name: llmrust
description: Machine-readable capability metadata for llmrust. AI agents can use this to discover what features each provider supports without reading source code. Note: 'support' means llmrust maps the field or protocol; actual upstream model support may vary.

reasoning.notes: Request: reasoning_effort mapping (budget None -> medium; Some rejected). Stream: reasoning/reasoning_content -> StreamChunk.thinking. Usage: reasoning_tokens -> Usage.reasoning_tokens. Non-stream chat and stream_collect* aggregate fail with LlmError::Unsupported (REA-001 §2.1/§3, REA-003). Fixture-level verification; real upstream E2E belongs to E2E-001.

notes: Uses native Anthropic Messages API (not OpenAI-compatible)
Images via base64 in content blocks
Tool calling via tool_use/tool_result content blocks

reasoning.notes: Request: thinking {type: enabled, budget_tokens} mapping. Stream: thinking_delta/signature_delta/redacted_thinking -> StreamChunk.thinking, thinking_done terminal. Usage: cache_creation_input_tokens/cache_read_input_tokens + thinking_tokens mapping. Non-stream chat and stream_collect* aggregate fail with LlmError::Unsupported (REA-001 §2.3/§3, REA-002). Fixture-level verification; real upstream E2E belongs to E2E-001.

notes: Remote http(s) image URLs are skipped. Use data: URLs only.
API key sent via x-goog-api-key header

reasoning.notes: Request: thinkingConfig (thinkingBudget optional, includeThoughts always when enabled). Stream: thought parts -> StreamChunk.thinking, thinking_done terminal. Usage: thoughtsTokenCount -> Usage.reasoning_tokens. Non-stream chat and stream_collect* aggregate fail with LlmError::Unsupported (REA-001 §2.5/§3, REA-004G). Fixture-level verification; real upstream E2E belongs to E2E-001.

ollama.description: Ollama local models (llama3.2, qwen2.5, any local model)
notes: No request timeout (local generation can be long-running)
Image content is flattened to text

reasoning.notes: Ollama wire offers only options.think (bool/level) with no lossless mapping for ThinkingConfig.budget_tokens; setting thinking fails with LlmError::Unsupported before any network call (REA-001 §2.5/§3, REA-004O). Fixture-level verification.

default.description: LLM client — all providers + streaming + embeddings + tool calling

proxy.description: Built-in multi-protocol HTTP proxy (OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Embeddings)

embeddings.notes: OpenAI-compatible embeddings transport is implemented. Ollama uses native /api/embed. Actual upstream model support varies by provider/model.

routing.description: LmrsClient parses provider/model prefix to select the registered provider

retry.mechanism: RetryProvider wraps any Provider with exponential backoff

router.description: Multi-deployment routing with failover, load balancing, and optional passive cooldown
router.groups: Logical group names mapped to ordered deployment lists
router.cooldown_policy: opt-in; failoverable errors mark deployments cooling; all-cooling groups fail open

responses_endpoint.conversion: input/instructions/tools (Responses shape) -> llmrust ChatRequest; ChatResponse/StreamChunk -> Responses object/SSE

proxy.n_policy: Accepts missing n or n = 1; rejects n = 0 or n > 1 to prevent silent multi-completion billing

design_principles: default = [] — no optional dependencies unless explicitly requested
Native protocols for Anthropic and Gemini (not OpenAI-compatible shims)
Stream errors are surfaced, never silently dropped
No logging of API keys, prompts, responses, request bodies, tool arguments, image data, embedding input text, embedding vectors, or full URLs
All providers implement both chat and stream
Provider trait is minimal: required chat() + stream(), optional default embed()
